This is LeetCode's Intersection of Two Linked Lists, restated over an arena so the two lists can share a tail without two owners of the same node. Walk the first list and record every index it visits in a hash set. Walk the second list and return the first index already in that set. The lists never diverge again once they meet, so the first shared index found from either side names the same node.
